algorithms.title: Crush Syndrome Field Protocol
steps: Scene safety with USAR; do not enter unshored voids.
Establish IV/IO; normal saline ~1–1.5 L/h adult (pediatric weight-based) BEFORE release.
Cardiac monitor; check for peaked T waves/QRS widening.
Prepare calcium, sodium bicarbonate, nebulized albuterol per protocol.
If no access and release can't wait: consider proximal tourniquet before release per protocol.
Release; watch for arrhythmia/hypotension; treat hyperkalemia; continue fluids; transport to a center with dialysis capability.

algorithms.title: Crowd Crush Response
steps: Alert event control/security: stop inflow, open exits, stop the show/music if needed.
Approach from the edges; remove barriers if they trap people.
Extract victims; open airway, high-flow O2, ventilate apneic patients if resources allow.
Triage (START/SALT); treat traumatic asphyxia and fractures.
Re-triage; watch for delayed hypoxia; track patients for reunification.
